A kind habit

Back at the sink, Little made a soft lather. Soap can pull apart the oily outer layers of many germs. It also loosens germs from skin.

5

Instructions in a coat

The next guest was much smaller. A virus is a tiny package of instructions in a coat, not a cell. It cannot make copies alone.

4

A whole little cell

Little paused at a yogurt cup. “Are all bacteria a problem?” “Many are helpers,” said Big.

3

Guests beyond our eyes

Little Wonderer held a magnifier beside the sink. “Can I see the tiny guests on my hands?” “Germs are far too small for just our eyes,” said Big.

2

Different tiny guests

“Does one medicine work on both guests?” Little asked. Big shook their head.

6

A clue to remember

“Your immune system is your body’s team of defenders,” said Big. “Some learn to recognize germs and remember them next time.”

Make a little book

  1. 1Fold it into 8 boxes. Open it flat.

  2. 2Fold short end to short end. Cut the thick line. Open it.

  3. 3Fold the long way, pictures out. Push the ends in.

  4. 4Fold into a book. Page 1 goes on the front!
